content.evidence_note: Actual worked literature mechanism read in the registered v2. This is a Proof Method recipe with transfer obligations, not an additional Theorem, Algorithm or complete Hard Family record.
failure_modes: Fresh-independent value noise destroys the persistent-handle model.
Overlapping informative supports can expose several hidden directions in one scalar.
Treating the shadow experiment as the true fixed oracle invalidates realizability.
Conditioning on geometric misses can change the posterior.
Dropping G before applying terminal-room necessity applies model membership to invalid instances.
Global-gap or arbitrary-radius claims do not follow from the local-gap construction.
content.goal_pattern: Force repeated direction learning at sequential spatial stages despite adaptive reuse of sampled functions.
content.key_choice: Use the genuine fixed sample law F_U(x;h)=-gamma s+lambda rho sum_{j=1}^M b_{U_j+sigma Z_{h,j}}((x-c_j)/rho)+gamma rho tau0((x-c_{M+1})/rho). Public information is the ball, model parameters and construction law; U_j and handle noise vectors are hidden. The full true function contains every room from the outset. A shadow experiment suppressing future rooms is only an analysis coupling, not an admissible replacement oracle.
content.key_relation: For each current room, exact values after subtracting the carrier are linear measurements of fixed V_{h,j}=U_j+sigma Z_{h,j}. With within-handle spans P_h, posterior covariance is n^(-1)(I+sigma^(-2)sum_h P_h)^(-1). Each scalar increases sum_h rank(P_h) by at most one. Before q0 rank increments, any estimate within 1/16 has conditional probability <=exp(-cn). Sequential depth M=Theta(HDelta/eta²) multiplies per-stage q0=Theta(dL0²/eta²).
proof_skeleton: Section 5.2 equations (5.2)–(5.16) define disjoint supports by clock spacing. On G={max_j||U_j||<=2}, every room lies in X. The mean replaces U_j+sigma Z_{h,j} by U_j. Lemma 5.1 and Appendix B calibrate global smoothness, sample Lipschitz second moment and local gap. Outside the terminal room ||grad f||>=7gamma/8>eta; its center has zero gradient.

Lemma 6.1 Gram–Schmidt removes redundant same-handle queries. Predictable innovation directions contribute Gaussian precision n aa^T/sigma². Replays do not create fresh noise. Lemma 6.2 bounds posterior small balls using at least 3n/4 covariance eigenvalues >=4/(5n).

Section 6.2 grants free disclosure of U_j only after q0 rank increments and then advances the current stage. This strengthens the algorithm. Couple true and shadow experiments with identical hidden vectors, noises and seed; the shadow activates only past/current bumps.

The shadow filtration contains neither suppressed-room membership nor conditions on previous misses. Future directions remain independent. A proposed point's clock coordinate selects at most one future index k; entering B_k implies estimating U_j within rho/a=1/16 after conditioning on independent intervening future directions.

Lemma 6.3 applies at every shadow proposal and the arbitrary final output. Union bound yields future-hit probability <=(N+1)exp(-cn). True and shadow transcripts agree until a hit. If N<Mq0, all stages cannot unlock, so success intersect G is contained in the future-hit event.

Use P(G)>=7/8 and n>=C log(2+Mq0) to obtain conditional average success <=2/7<1/2 for sufficiently small budgets, hence a fixed valid instance. Keep the Gaussian prior unconditioned during information analysis and restrict to G only at final averaging.
Section 6.3 uses the complete smooth-to-Goldstein transfer stored in the linked theorem: H=epsilon/delta, eta=2epsilon, preserving the query ball, persistent loss law and stationary-point promise.
content.required_inputs: A fixed smooth compact cutoff chi(y)=psi(||y||²), equal to one for ||y||<=1/4 and zero for ||y||>=1; b_v(y)=chi(y)<v,y_perp> and tau0(y)=chi(y)y0 with dimension-independent derivative constant Cchi. Let d=n+1, x=(s,z), gamma=4eta, rho=Crho gamma/H, ell=4rho, a=16rho, lambda=gamma/(16Cchi), M=floor(cM HDelta/gamma²)>=2. Hidden U_j are independent N(0,I_n/n); c1=0, c_{j+1}=c_j+ell e0+a(0,U_j), B_j=B(c_j,rho), R=40M rho. Every independent handle h contains independent Z_{h,j}~N(0,I_n/n), permanently retained for its lifetime. Set sigma²=c_sigma L0²/gamma² and q0=floor(n sigma²/16).
transfer_obligations: Construct one fixed random loss law realizing every repeated handle answer; do not generate history-dependent fresh answers.
Reprove derivative, sample Lipschitz moment and local-gap calibration, including Gaussian maximum dependence on the number of rooms.
Prove the posterior formula for the actual permitted adaptive feedback and count innovation rank rather than handles or replays.
Establish the shadow filtration invariant without conditioning on previous misses; show true/shadow equality until first disagreement.
Control arbitrary unqueried output and retain the valid-instance event in the information-to-error implication.
Recalibrate dimension, radius, success probability and budget convention; the product expression alone proves no hardness.
